🕒 Update schedule
Update schedule (Eastern, approximate)

All pages (D/ST, Kickers, ROS, Players, DFS) refresh together in each run: new lines, props, weather and starters. Runs are started early to allow for GitHub’s queue, so pages are usually updated around these times. The weekly models refit on Tuesdays. Games lock at kickoff.

past weeks

Player projections — 2026 week 10

Props updated Tue Nov 10 7:18 PM ET (median of up to 4 sportsbooks; 7 of 14 games with props) · weekly bundle Tue Nov 10. Italic rows (7 games without props yet): recent history adjusted for the implied total and spread, until that game's props post; see the Glossary. Vegas-only: sportsbook player props (pass / rush / receiving yards, attempts, receptions, pass TDs, INTs, anytime TD) converted to expected stats and scored in your format. In back-tests (2024–26) no model or extra stats beat these at kickoff. Hover a column header for its definition; click to sort.

Key
Tierstier 1tier 2bottom two tiersclear dropsofter breakhover or tap a name for what drives the projection
Range barlight = 80% of outcomesdark = 50%tick = projectionorange = the ± (how sure the projection is)
Vs ECR🔥 love: our Vegas-only position rank at least 50% higher👍 like: 25–50% higher🤔 dislike: 25–50% lower☠️ fade: at least 50% lower(gap ÷ the better rank; at least 3 spots)
Other rankingsthat source ranks him 25–50% higher or lower than we do50%+ apart(gap ÷ the better rank; at least 3 spots; one of the two ranks inside RB 36 / WR 54 / TE 18 (any QB))
Status🔒 game started: frozen at the last pre-kickoff line(Q) / (D) / (O), IR: injury status (red = ruled out or doubtful)italic no props yet: projected from his history(TD) = TD-only prop

How each ranking did once the games were played, on the same players each week (those with a Vegas projection that every source ranked; each source re-ranked within them). Vegas-only = our projection from the props 60 minutes before kickoff (calibrations fit on other seasons). ECR = FantasyPros expert consensus, the last version before kickoff (PPR ranks in every format). ESPN / Sleeper = their projected stats scored in this format (weeks before the site started: their projections pulled after the week). Seasons 2023–2026, through 2026 week 9.

Rank corr = Spearman correlation with actual points. NDCG = top-weighted ranking score (1 = perfect order; mistakes near the top cost most). Top-N pts = average actual points of the source's top N (QB 12, RB 24, WR 36, TE 12). RMSE = projection error in points (ECR has none except FantasyPros' projection in PPR). Bold = best at the position.

How each ranking did once the games were played, on the same players each week (those with a Vegas projection that every source ranked; each source re-ranked within them). Vegas-only = our projection from the props 60 minutes before kickoff (calibrations fit on other seasons). ECR = FantasyPros expert consensus, the last version before kickoff (PPR ranks in every format). ESPN / Sleeper = their projected stats scored in this format (weeks before the site started: their projections pulled after the week). Seasons 2023–2026, through 2026 week 9.

Rank corr = Spearman correlation with actual points. NDCG = top-weighted ranking score (1 = perfect order; mistakes near the top cost most). Top-N pts = average actual points of the source's top N (QB 12, RB 24, WR 36, TE 12). RMSE = projection error in points (ECR has none except FantasyPros' projection in PPR). Bold = best at the position.

How each ranking did once the games were played, on the same players each week (those with a Vegas projection that every source ranked; each source re-ranked within them). Vegas-only = our projection from the props 60 minutes before kickoff (calibrations fit on other seasons). ECR = FantasyPros expert consensus, the last version before kickoff (PPR ranks in every format). ESPN / Sleeper = their projected stats scored in this format (weeks before the site started: their projections pulled after the week). Seasons 2023–2026, through 2026 week 9.

Rank corr = Spearman correlation with actual points. NDCG = top-weighted ranking score (1 = perfect order; mistakes near the top cost most). Top-N pts = average actual points of the source's top N (QB 12, RB 24, WR 36, TE 12). RMSE = projection error in points (ECR has none except FantasyPros' projection in PPR). Bold = best at the position.

How each ranking did once the games were played, on the same players each week (those with a Vegas projection that every source ranked; each source re-ranked within them). Vegas-only = our projection from the props 60 minutes before kickoff (calibrations fit on other seasons). ECR = FantasyPros expert consensus, the last version before kickoff (PPR ranks in every format). ESPN / Sleeper = their projected stats scored in this format (weeks before the site started: their projections pulled after the week). Seasons 2023–2026, through 2026 week 9.

Rank corr = Spearman correlation with actual points. NDCG = top-weighted ranking score (1 = perfect order; mistakes near the top cost most). Top-N pts = average actual points of the source's top N (QB 12, RB 24, WR 36, TE 12). RMSE = projection error in points (ECR has none except FantasyPros' projection in PPR). Bold = best at the position.

TermDefinition
RankRank at the position in this format.
TierNatural-break tier of the projections (optimal 1-D grouping; 1 = best). Solid line = a gap of 1.5+ points between tiers; dashed = a smaller gap.
PlayerVegas flags vs FantasyPros ECR, from our Vegas-only position rank: 🔥 love = at least 50% higher than ECR, 👍 like = 25–50% higher, 🤔 dislike = 25–50% lower, ☠️ fade = at least 50% lower (always at least 3 spots). The % is the gap divided by the better of the two ranks, so 2 spots matters more near the top (WR8 vs WR10 = 25%) than further down. Hover or tap a player for the exact difference.
KickoffKickoff (Eastern). 🔒 = game started: frozen at the last props pulled before kickoff.
ImpTeam implied points from the latest pre-kickoff spread and total (median of sportsbooks, from the D/ST page's line pulls).
ProjVegas-only projection: the sportsbook props converted to expected stats (yardage medians corrected for skew, counts via a Poisson fit to line and odds, anytime-TD price calibrated on 2023+ results) and scored in this format.
ΔChange since the first point of his Trend (blank for TD-only and no-props rows).
TrendProjection at every props pull this week, starting once his own yardage / receptions props are posted (open dot = that first pull; pulls with only anytime-TD prices are left out) and stopping at kickoff. TD-only (TD) and no-props rows have no trend. Green = up, red = down. Hover a dot for the time.
P(boom)Chance of a boom week: half PPR QB 25+, RB / WR 20+, TE 15+ (other formats: the same share of player-games; FLEX uses each player's own position). Logistic fit per position on the Vegas projection and the anytime-TD price, 2023+: at the same projection a higher TD chance means more boom weeks, strongest for RBs, so RB P(boom) doesn't follow the rank exactly.
P(bust)Chance of a bust week: half PPR QB under 12, RB / WR under 6, TE under 4 (other formats: the same share). Logistic fit on the Vegas projection, 2023+.
TD%Anytime-TD price as a probability (median across books; includes the books' margin). Expected TDs in the projection are calibrated from it. On rows without props yet: the sportsbook price when one is posted (it then sets his expected TDs), otherwise italic* = the price implied by his expected TDs from history.
BooksSportsbooks behind the median lines (most for any one of this player's markets).
P(2+ TD)Chance of 2+ rushing / receiving TDs. Plain = the sportsbooks' own price (player TDs over 1.5, median across books, margin removed); italic* = no price posted, estimated from his anytime-TD price (and expected yards) with a fit on 2023+ results. Hover for both numbers.
P(100+)Chance of 100+ yards: RB rushing + receiving yards together, WR / TE receiving yards. Plain = the sportsbooks' alternate-line ladder at 100 (median across books, margin removed; RBs: the rush + rec yards market, which DraftKings, BetMGM, BetRivers, FanDuel and Bovada post for each team's lead backs); italic* = estimated from his Vegas-only expected yards (fit on 2023+ results). Hover for both numbers.
P(2+ TD or 100+)Chance of a boom game by either route: 2+ TDs or 100+ yards (as P(100+)). Combined from the two columns with a fit on 2023+ results (the two often happen together, so it is less than adding them). Italic* when neither part has a sportsbook price.
P(no TD)Chance he doesn't score a rushing / receiving TD (a floor number). Italic* = 1 minus his anytime-TD price calibrated on 2023+ results (The Odds API doesn't carry DraftKings' "not to score" market; a book's "No" price would be shown plain if one ever comes through) (the TD% column includes the books' margin, so this is a little higher than 100% minus TD%).
P(300+)Chance of 300+ passing yards (DraftKings' +3 bonus). Plain = the sportsbooks' alternate passing-yards ladder at 300 (median across books, margin removed); italic* = estimated from his expected passing yards (fit on 2023+ results). Hover for both numbers.
Pass attExpected pass attempts (volume; doesn't score).
Rush attExpected rushing attempts (volume; doesn't score).
PosFLEX tab: the player's rank at his own position in this format.
±Model uncertainty of the projection, like the kicker and D/ST pages: half the width of its 90% bootstrap interval. Each of 60 draws resamples the sportsbooks behind the median lines (with replacement, per game) and uses one of 100 bootstrap refits of the props-to-stats calibration; the interval is the 5th to 95th percentile of the projections. Wide = books disagree, thin markets or lines far from typical. Hover for the interval. It measures how sure we are of the projection, not how much the player's score can swing (that is the range bar).
Range barHow much his score can swing: light band = 80% of outcomes (10th to 90th percentile), dark band = 50% (25th to 75th), line = projection; the small orange band around the line = the ± (90% interval of the projection itself). From quantile regression on 2023+ player-games with the same projection (adding the TD price, implied total or spread didn't help). Same scale within a table.
Injury(Q) Questionable, (D) Doubtful, (O) Out, IR / PUP / NFI / SUS after the name: the official NFL injury report's game status once it is out (Friday), before that Sleeper's status; IR / PUP / suspensions from either. Checked at every refresh and frozen at kickoff. Hover the player for practice participation and the injury. Red = ruled out or doubtful.
ECRFantasyPros expert consensus rank at the position (via DynastyProcess, updated about 10 am / 10 pm ET; the last one before kickoff). RB / WR / TE ranks are PPR in every format. Hover for the average rank, spread across experts and FantasyPros' projected PPR points. Shaded when ECR ranks him at least 25% (pale) or 50% (strong) higher or lower than our position rank: the gap divided by the better of the two ranks, at least 3 spots, and one of the two inside RB 36 / WR 54 / TE 18 (any QB rank).
ESPN rkESPN's projected stats scored in this format, ranked at the position (last pull before kickoff); projected points in brackets. Shaded as for ECR.
Sleeper rkSleeper's projected stats (Rotowire) scored in this format, ranked at the position (last pull before kickoff); projected points in brackets. Shaded as for ECR.
Italic*Italic* = no prop for this stat: receptions from the receiving-yards prop and the player's yards per catch (or the reverse); otherwise his recency-weighted career average per game, shrunk toward players at his position without that prop.
Italic row: no props yetGames whose props aren't posted yet (usually Tuesday–Wednesday). Every stat is the player's recent history (recency-weighted, ×0.9 per game, ×0.5 per offseason, shrunk toward his position), scored in the format and adjusted for this game's implied team total vs his team's recent scoring and for the spread (fit on 2019–25). Players shown: active-roster players with enough recent production, the team's latest starting QB, and nobody ruled out or doubtful. No ±, love / fade or amber flags, since those are Vegas calls. The TD% is implied by his expected TDs. Each player switches to props as soon as his game has them. In the 2023–25 back-test it ranks players less well than the props (half PPR weekly rank correlation with results, same players: QB 0.32 vs 0.36, RB 0.54 vs 0.61, TE 0.47 vs 0.54, WR 0.50 vs 0.56).
(TD)TD-only player: no yardage or receptions prop, shown because his anytime-TD price is at or above the median of players at his position with full props.
FormatsStandard / Half PPR / PPR: ESPN defaults (0.04 per pass yard, pass TD 4, INT −2, fumble lost −2, 0 / 0.5 / 1 per catch). FFPC: 0.05 per pass yard, INT −1, fumble lost −1, 1 per catch, 1.5 per TE catch. 6-pt pass TD (QB tab): Standard with 6 points per passing TD. The QB tab shows Standard / FFPC / 6-pt pass TD only: Half PPR and PPR score QBs the same as Standard.
